senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. preced. wds.) [to gather humors, to sleep well (cmp. יָשַׁן).—Denom. חֲלוֹם (cmp. ἐνύπνιος, somnium) dream; from which חָלַם] to dream.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55b:11">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>חלום חָלַמְתִּי</he> I had a dream.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>חלום שׁח׳ לו חבירו</he> a dream which his neighbor had about him.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:7">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:7">VII</cite>), 7 <he>שתהא חוֹלֵם חלומות</he> that you may have dreams; a. fr.
